copy.tl: Ang isang recipe ng strawberry jam na nangangailangan ng 55% sugar solution sa 300 ml na concentrate ay nangangailangan ng 165 gramo ng asukal, dahil ang 55% ng 300 ay 165.
copy.bis: Ang usa ka resipe sa strawberry jam nga nagkinahanglan ug 55% sugar solution sa 300 ml nga concentrate nagkinahanglan ug 165 gramos nga asukar, tungod kay ang 55% sa 300 kay 165.

Bakit sa mga lugar tulad ng San Lorenzo itinayo ang mga wind turbine at hindi kung saan-saan lang?

Kailangan nila ng angkop na kondisyon ng hangin, tulad ng tuloy-tuloy at sapat na lakas, para gumana nang mahusay at makagawa ng sapat na kuryente.
copy.bis:
Ngano nga ang mga wind turbine gitukod sa mga lugar sama sa San Lorenzo ug dili lang bisan asa?

copy.en:
Does a bigger surface area make more friction?

Yes! When more of an object's surface touches the floor, there are more places for tiny bumps to catch, so friction increases.
copy.tl:
Mas marami bang friction kapag mas malaki ang surface area?

Oo! Kapag mas malaking bahagi ng surface ng bagay ang dumadikit sa sahig, mas maraming lugar para sumabit ang maliliit na bukol, kaya tumataas ang friction.
copy.bis:
Mas daghan ba ang friction kon mas dako ang surface area?

Oo! Kon mas dako nga parte sa surface sa butang ang modapat sa salog, mas daghan ang lugar nga masangitan sa gagmay nga bukol, busa motaas ang friction.

copy.en:
Can a nerve signal cross a synapse both ways?

No — a signal crosses the synapse in only one direction. One neuron always sends the chemical, and the other only receives it.
copy.tl:
Puwede bang dumaan ang signal sa synapse pabalik-balik?

Hindi — ang signal ay dumadaan sa synapse sa iisang direksyon lamang. Ang isang neuron ang laging nagpapadala ng kemikal, at ang isa ay tumatanggap lamang.
copy.bis:
Mahimo ba nga motabok balik-balik ang signal sa synapse?

Dili — ang signal motabok sa synapse sa usa lang ka direksyon. Ang usa ka neuron kanunay ang nagpadala sa kemikal, ug ang lain modawat lamang.

Giunsa nimo pagpakigsulti si Lola nga nagpuyo sa layo?

Ang cellphone o telepono mogamit ug kuryente aron mapadala ang imong tingog ngadto kaniya, mao nga makasulti mo bisan layo kaayo.

copy.bis: Ang tarsier mokapyot sa kahoy alang sa puy-anan ug aron makita ang palibot alang sa posibleng tukbonon, apan ang kahoy dili maunsa.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: When milk sours and tastes bitter or sharp, that change in taste is a clue that a chemical change has occurred.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: use local information or other reliable sources to identify where the nearest active and inactive volcanoes are located and assess the risk of impacts from eruptions to their local community
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses a chemical change (milk souring) and has no connection to volcanoes, their locations, or eruption risk assessment.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: When milk sours and tastes bitter or sharp, that change in taste is a clue that a chemical change has occurred.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: Interpret PHIVOLCS Volcano Monitoring (Alert Levels) to demonstrate what to do before, during, and after a volcanic eruption
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about a chemical change clue, not about interpreting PHIVOLCS alert levels or volcano eruption preparedness.

copy.en: When milk sours and tastes bitter or sharp, that change in taste is a clue that a chemical change has occurred.
copy.tl: Kapag ang gatas ay umasim at naging mapait o matapang ang lasa, ang pagbabagong iyon sa lasa ay isang clue na may naganap na chemical change.
copy.bis: Kon ang gatas moaslom ug mahimong pait o isog ang lami, kana nga pag-usab sa lami usa ka clue nga adunay nahitabo nga chemical change.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: They use a ladder of groups from kingdom down to species
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explain what volcanoes are and how they are formed
assignedReviews.reason: The card explains the hierarchical taxonomic classification of living things (kingdom to species). G6-E-1 requires explaining what volcanoes are and how they are formed. The card provides no information about volcanoes, volcanic activity, or Earth/space science, so it is unrelated to the assigned competency.

copy.en:
Why do scientists use so many levels to name one living thing?

They use a ladder of groups from kingdom down to species so every organism gets its own exact address in the living world!
copy.tl:
Bakit ang daming level na ginagamit ng mga scientist para pangalanan ang isang bagay na may buhay?

Gumagamit sila ng hagdan ng mga grupo mula kingdom pababa sa species para magkaroon ang bawat organismo ng sarili nitong eksaktong address sa mundo ng may buhay!
copy.bis:
Ngano daghan man kaayo ug level ang gigamit sa mga scientist para nganlan ang usa ka buhing butang?

Gigamit nila ang hagdan sa mga grupo gikan sa kingdom paubos sa species aron ang matag organismo adunay kaugalingong eksaktong address sa kalibutan sa mga buhi!

assignedReviews.card_evidence: TB treatment combines several medicines together because that combination kills the bacteria better than just one drug alone.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: recognize that some organisms consist of a single cell (unicellular) like in bacteria and some consist of many cells (multicellular) like in a human
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses TB treatment and drug combinations, not the distinction between unicellular organisms (like bacteria) and multicellular organisms (like humans). Mentioning bacteria does not teach the competency's concept of cellular organization.

copy.en: TB treatment combines several medicines together because that combination kills the bacteria better than just one drug alone.
copy.tl: Gumagamit ng ilang gamot nang sabay-sabay ang paggamot sa TB dahil mas mabisa itong pumapatay sa bakterya kaysa iisang gamot lang.
copy.bis: Ang pagtambal sa TB naggamit og daghang tambal nga dungan kay mas epektibo kining mopatay sa bakterya kaysa usa ra ka tambal.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: To confirm TB is truly cured, doctors run tests like checking phlegm or an x-ray after treatment is finished.

assignedReviews.reason: The card describes medical tests to confirm TB cure. It does not identify a science invention, use information from home or local community, or explain an invention's impact on everyday life. The content is unrelated to the competency.

copy.en: To confirm TB is truly cured, doctors run tests like checking phlegm or an x-ray after treatment is finished.
copy.tl: Para malaman kung talagang gumaling na sa TB, may mga pagsusuri tulad ng pagsuri sa plema o x-ray na kinukumpirma ng doktor pagkatapos ng gamutan.
copy.bis: Aron mahibal-an kung tinuod nga naayo na sa TB, ang doktor mokumpirma pinaagi sa mga pagsusi sama sa pag-check sa plema o x-ray human sa pagtambal.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: a thin layer of tears spreads over your eye
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: observe and describe the outer body parts of animals, such as head, legs or wings, and identify their role to move and to gather food
assignedReviews.reason: The competency is about observing and describing outer body parts of animals (head, legs, wings) and their role in movement and food gathering. Tears are not an outer body part, and the card does not address movement or food gathering. It is unrelated to the competency.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: a thin layer of tears spreads over your eye
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe in simple terms how the following human body systems work: muscular, skeletal, digestive, circulatory, and respiratory
assignedReviews.reason: The competency requires describing how the muscular, skeletal, digestive, circulatory, or respiratory systems work. Tears and eye protection are not part of any of these systems. The card does not support this competency.

copy.en: Every time you blink, a thin layer of tears spreads over your eye — keeping it wet, clean, and free of dust.
copy.tl: Tuwing kumukurap ka, kumakalat ang manipis na luha sa mata mo — pinananatili nitong basa at malinis ito, at hinuhugasan ang alikabok.
copy.bis: Matag mopamilok ka, mokatag ang nipis nga luha sa imong mata — nagpabilin niini nga basa ug limpyo, ug ginahugasan ang abog.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: A tear has three thin layers: oil on the outside, water in the middle, and sticky mucus inside
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe useful everyday examples of uniform and non-uniform mixtures, such as solutions and suspensions
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes the layered composition of tears (oil, water, mucus), which is a biological/anatomical fact. It does not describe uniform or non-uniform mixtures, solutions, or suspensions, nor does it classify tears as a mixture. The content is unrelated to the competency about everyday examples of mixtures.

copy.en: A tear has three thin layers: oil on the outside, water in the middle, and sticky mucus inside — together they stop it from drying up too fast!
copy.tl: Ang luha ay may tatlong manipis na sapin: langis sa labas, tubig sa gitna, at malagkit na bahagi sa loob — magkasama silang pumipigil sa mabilis na pagtuyo ng luha!
copy.bis: Ang luha adunay tulo ka nipis nga patong: lana sa gawas, tubig sa tunga, ug pilit nga bahin sa sulod — magkahiusa sila nga nagpugong sa dali nga pagkauga sa luha!

assignedReviews.card_evidence: During telophase I, chromosomes decondense, nuclear membranes reform, and cytokinesis produces two haploid daughter cells.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explore and demonstrate different ways to make objects move by natural causes, such as wind and water, or by people, such as pushing, pulling, rolling, and carrying
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes events of telophase I in meiosis, a cell division process in biology. copy.en: During telophase I, chromosomes decondense, nuclear membranes reform, and cytokinesis produces two haploid daughter cells.
copy.tl: Sa telophase I, nagdedecondense ang chromosomes, nabubuo muli ang nuclear membranes, at gumagawa ang cytokinesis ng dalawang haploid daughter cells.
copy.bis: Sa telophase I, magdecondense ang chromosomes, maporma pag-usab ang nuclear membranes, ug mopatungha ang cytokinesis og duha ka haploid daughter cells.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Temperate regions are areas between the hot tropics and the cold poles
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: participate in guided investigations to infer the relationship among current, voltage, and resistance in assembled series and parallel circuits with varying number of loads and battery
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes temperate climate zones and seasons, which has no connection to electrical circuits, current, voltage, resistance, or series/parallel circuits. The assigned competency is entirely unrelated to the card content.

copy.en: Temperate regions are areas between the hot tropics and the cold poles, where the four seasons are most clearly experienced.
copy.tl: Ang temperate regions ay mga lugar sa pagitan ng mainit na tropics at malamig na poles, kung saan pinakamalinaw na nararanasan ang apat na seasons.
copy.bis: Ang temperate regions mao ang mga lugar tali sa init nga tropics ug bugnaw nga poles, diin labing klaro nga masinati ang upat ka seasons.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: adding heat can turn a solid into a liquid, and a liquid into a gas
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: write the chemical formula and chemical name of some common covalent compounds, including water (H2O), carbon dioxide (CO2), and ammonia (NH3)
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes physical changes of state due to heat. It does not address chemical formulas or names of covalent compounds such as water, carbon dioxide, or ammonia.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: adding heat can turn a solid into a liquid, and a liquid into a gas
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the properties of pure substances as: a. having fixed chemical composition, examples of which are elements and compounds, and b. that all the atoms of an element have a unique number of protons
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about temperature-induced changes of state, not about pure substances having fixed chemical composition or atoms of an element having a unique number of protons.

copy.en: Temperature affects materials: adding heat can turn a solid into a liquid, and a liquid into a gas.
copy.tl: Nakakaapekto ang temperature sa mga materyal: ang pagdagdag ng init ay maaaring magpabago ng solid patungong liquid, at ng liquid patungong gas.
copy.bis: Ang temperature makaapekto sa mga materyal: ang pagdugang og kainit makapausab sa solid ngadto sa liquid, ug sa liquid ngadto sa gas.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: The three common temperature scales are Celsius, Fahrenheit, and Kelvin
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explain that the formation of new bonds or the breaking of existing bonds constitutes a chemical change and the formation of a new substance
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes temperature scales and their reference points. It contains no information about chemical bonds, bond breaking/formation, or chemical change, which are the focus of G9-M-2.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: The three common temperature scales are Celsius, Fahrenheit, and Kelvin
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the properties of pure substances as: a. having fixed chemical composition, examples of which are elements and compounds, and b. that all the atoms of an element have a unique number of protons
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about temperature measurement scales, not about pure substances, fixed chemical composition, elements/compounds, or atomic protons. It does not support G8-M-4.

copy.en: The three common temperature scales are Celsius, Fahrenheit, and Kelvin, each using the freezing and boiling points of water as reference points.
copy.tl: Ang tatlong karaniwang temperature scale ay Celsius, Fahrenheit, at Kelvin, na ginagamit ang freezing point at boiling point ng tubig bilang mga reference point.
copy.bis: Ang tulo ka kasagarang temperature scale mao ang Celsius, Fahrenheit, ug Kelvin, nga naggamit sa freezing point ug boiling point sa tubig isip mga reference point.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Tension is the force that travels through a string
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explain the role of the water cycle in the environment
assignedReviews.reason: The card defines tension force, a physics concept. It provides no information about the water cycle or its role in the environment.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Tension is the force that travels through a string
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify local examples of natural landforms and bodies of water such as mountains, valleys, rivers, and coastlines, and describe how they influence non-living and living components of the environment
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about tension force, not landforms, bodies of water, or their influence on the environment. No direct or prerequisite support.

assignedReviews.competency_evidence: use a table to show how living things can be classified into groups based on similar characteristics (plants including flowering and non-flowering; animals including mammals, reptiles, insects, birds, fish, amphibians; microorganisms including fungi and bacteria)
assignedReviews.reason: Tension on a rope is unrelated to using a table to classify living things.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Tension is the force applied to a string, rope, chain, or cable, like the rope holding a hanging ball
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the differences between animals with a backbone (vertebrates) and animals without backbones (invertebrates) by using common local examples of each group
assignedReviews.reason: Tension on a rope is unrelated to animals with or without a backbone.

copy.en: Tension is the force applied to a string, rope, chain, or cable, like the rope holding a hanging ball.
copy.tl: Ang tension ay ang force na inilalapat sa string, lubid, kadena, o cable, tulad ng lubid na humahawak sa nakabiting bola.
copy.bis: Ang tension mao ang force nga gibutang sa string, pisi, kadena, o cable, sama sa pisi nga nagkupot sa nagbitay nga bola.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Terrestrial ecosystems have energy pyramids too
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe matter as anything that has mass and takes up space
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses energy pyramids in terrestrial ecosystems, which is an ecology topic. G5-M-1 requires describing matter as anything that has mass and takes up space. The card provides no information about matter, mass, or volume, so it does not support this competency.

copy.en: Terrestrial ecosystems have energy pyramids too, with grasses and trees as producers at the bottom and predators like eagles at the top.
copy.tl: Ang mga terrestrial ecosystem ay may energy pyramid din, kung saan ang mga damo at puno ang mga producer sa ilalim at ang mga predator tulad ng agila ang nasa tuktok.
copy.bis: Ang mga terrestrial ecosystem aduna usab energy pyramid, diin ang mga sagbot ug kahoy mao ang mga producer sa ubos ug ang mga predator sama sa agila mao ang naa sa tumoy.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Scientists use models to test ideas safely
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe changes in properties of materials when exposed to certain changes in temperature, such as changes when wood or coal are burned
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about using models to test ideas safely (e.g., flight simulation), which does not address changes in material properties due to temperature, such as burning wood or coal. It is unrelated to the competency.

copy.en: Scientists use models to test ideas safely, like using a flight simulation on a computer instead of risking a real airplane during a dangerous situation.
copy.tl: Gumagamit ang mga scientist ng mga model para subukan ang mga ideya nang ligtas, tulad ng paggamit ng flight simulation sa computer imbes na isugal ang isang totoong eroplano sa mapanganib na sitwasyon.
copy.bis: Ang mga scientist mogamit og mga model aron sulayan ang mga ideya nga luwas, sama sa paggamit sa flight simulation sa computer imbes nga i-risk ang usa ka tinuod nga eroplano sa peligro nga sitwasyon.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Always clean any wound right away.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify the basic needs of all living things, such as air, food, water, and shelter
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses tetanus transmission from animal bites, splinters, and dirty wounds, and wound cleaning. It does not address the basic needs of living things (air, food, water, shelter) required by G3-L-6.

copy.en:
Does tetanus only come from rusty nails?

No! You can also get tetanus from an animal bite, a wood splinter, or any deep dirty wound. Always clean any wound right away.
copy.tl:
Sa pako lang ba galing ang tetanus?

Hindi! Pwede rin makuha ang tetanus sa kagat ng hayop, salubsob na kahoy, o anumang malalim na sugat na napasukan ng dumi. Laging linisin ang sugat kaagad.
copy.bis:
Sa lansang ra ba gikan ang tetanus?

Dili! Makuha usab ang tetanus sa paak sa hayop, salbut nga kahoy, o bisan unsang lawom nga samad nga nasudlan og hugaw. Kanunay hinloi dayon ang samad.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: In Mendel's F2 monohybrid crosses
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: demonstrate various techniques in separating mixtures, such as decantation, winnowing, scooping, picking, evaporation, filtering, sieving, and using magnets
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses Mendelian genetics and the 3:1 phenotypic ratio, which has no connection to separating mixtures (decantation, winnowing, filtering, etc.).

assignedReviews.card_evidence: In Mendel's F2 monohybrid crosses
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe changes of state for solids, liquids, and gases as melting, evaporation, freezing, condensation using diagrams and flowcharts
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about inheritance ratios, not changes of state (melting, evaporation, freezing, condensation). No instructional support for this competency.

copy.en: In Mendel's F2 monohybrid crosses, about three offspring showed the dominant trait for every one offspring that showed the recessive trait, a 3:1 ratio.
copy.tl: Sa F2 monohybrid crosses ni Mendel, mga tatlong anak ang nagpakita ng dominant na katangian sa bawat isang anak na nagpakita ng recessive na katangian, isang 3:1 ratio.
copy.bis: Sa F2 monohybrid crosses ni Mendel, mga tulo ka anak ang nagpakita sa dominant nga kinaiya sa matag usa ka anak nga nagpakita sa recessive nga kinaiya, usa ka 3:1 ratio.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: The hock is the joint

assignedReviews.reason: The card describes a chicken's hock joint anatomy, which has no relation to identifying the role of solute and solvent in a solution.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: The hock is the joint
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe useful everyday examples of uniform and non-uniform mixtures, such as solutions and suspensions
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about a chicken leg joint, not about uniform or non-uniform mixtures such as solutions and suspensions.

copy.en: The hock is the joint between a chicken's drumstick and its ankle that allows the bird to bend its legs.
copy.tl: Ang hock ay ang joint sa pagitan ng drumstick ng manok at ng ankle nito na nagpapahintulot sa ibon na maibaluktot ang kanyang mga binti.
copy.bis: Ang hock mao ang joint tali sa drumstick sa manok ug sa iyang ankle nga nagtugot sa langgam sa pagbawog sa iyang mga tiil.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: A receptor is a specialized structure
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: draw the structure of an atom in terms of the nucleus and electron shells
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes biological receptors that detect stimuli, which is unrelated to drawing the structure of an atom in terms of nucleus and electron shells. No instructional support for the competency.

copy.en: A receptor is a specialized structure on or inside cells that detects a specific stimulus, like heat on your skin, and starts the body's response.
copy.tl: Ang receptor ay isang specialized structure sa o loob ng cells na dumidetekta ng partikular na stimulus, tulad ng init sa iyong balat, at nagsisimula ng tugon ng katawan.
copy.bis: Ang receptor usa ka specialized structure sa o sa sulod sa cells nga makadetect sa partikular nga stimulus, sama sa init sa imong panit, ug magsugod sa tubag sa lawas.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: The compound microscope is referred to as a light microscope because it uses light to illuminate the specimen
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: use information from secondary sources to describe that living things interact with each other in the natural environment, such as through competition, or predation
assignedReviews.reason: The card is not living things interacting through competition or predation.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: it uses light to illuminate the specimen
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: observe examples and explain how living things depend on one another and on the environment to meet their basic needs
assignedReviews.reason: The card is not how living things depend on one another to meet their basic needs.

copy.en: The compound microscope is referred to as a light microscope because it uses light to illuminate the specimen.
copy.tl: Ang compound microscope ay tinatawag na light microscope dahil gumagamit ito ng liwanag para mailawan ang specimen.
copy.bis: Ang compound microscope gitawag nga light microscope tungod kay naggamit kini og kahayag aron mailawan ang specimen.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: It is the dependent variable, the effect that arises from the changes in the independent variable.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: examine a local weather chart to make simple interpretations about the local weather and describe and practice safety precautions to use during poor or extreme weather conditions
assignedReviews.reason: The card defines the dependent variable in an experiment. copy.en:
What do you call the effect that changes because of what you did in an experiment?

It is the dependent variable, the effect that arises from the changes in the independent variable.
copy.tl:
Ano ang tawag sa epekto na nagbabago dahil sa ginawa mo sa isang experiment?

Ito ang dependent variable, ang epekto na nagmumula sa mga pagbabago sa independent variable.
copy.bis:
Unsa ang tawag sa epekto nga mausab tungod sa imong gibuhat sa usa ka experiment?

Kini ang dependent variable, ang epekto nga mogawas sa mga pagbag-o sa independent variable.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: The fine adjustment knob is turned for small, precise movements
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify that energy is something that can cause change including light, sound, and heat energy
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes the function of a microscope's fine adjustment knob. G4-F-9 is about energy causing change (light, sound, heat), which is unrelated to microscope operation.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: The fine adjustment knob is turned for small, precise movements
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explore and describe how sound is made and transferred in everyday situations, such as the ringing of a bell or the hearing of noises
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about microscope focusing, not about how sound is made or transferred. G3-F-4 is unrelated to this content.

copy.en: The fine adjustment knob is turned for small, precise movements to get a clearer, sharper view of the specimen.
copy.tl: Ang fine adjustment knob ay iniikot para sa maliliit at eksaktong galaw para makakuha ng mas malinaw na tingin sa specimen.
copy.bis: Ang fine adjustment knob gituyok para sa gagmay ug eksaktong mga lihok aron makakuha ug mas klaro nga pagtan-aw sa specimen.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: The tongue, salivary glands, liver, gallbladder, and pancreas are organs that help with digestion
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: assemble and draw a simple circuit using batteries, wires, switch, and bulb and/or toy motor or buzzer
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes accessory digestive organs, which is a biology/living-things topic. G5-F-8 requires assembling and drawing a simple electrical circuit, which is entirely unrelated to digestion.

copy.en: The tongue, salivary glands, liver, gallbladder, and pancreas are organs that help with digestion but are not part of the main digestive tract.
copy.tl: Ang dila, salivary glands, liver, gallbladder, at pancreas ay mga organ na tumutulong sa digestion pero hindi bahagi ng pangunahing digestive tract.
copy.bis: Ang dila, salivary glands, liver, gallbladder, ug pancreas mga organo nga motabang sa digestion apan dili bahin sa pangunang digestive tract.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Larvae hatch from eggs but do not look like adult insects
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: participate in guided science activities to explore and describe sources of light, how it behaves or can be changed, and its uses in everyday situations
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes the larval stage of insects, a biology/life-cycle topic. G3-F-6 concerns sources of light, light behavior, and uses of light in everyday situations. There is no connection to light or energy; the tag is unrelated.

copy.en: Larvae hatch from eggs but do not look like adult insects, and they grow quickly enough to molt several times before pupating.
copy.tl: Ang larvae ay napipisa mula sa itlog ngunit hindi kamukha ng mga adult na insekto, at mabilis silang lumaki kaya ilang beses silang nagmo-molt bago maging pupa.
copy.bis: Ang larvae mapusa gikan sa itlog apan dili parehas sa mga adult nga insekto, ug paspas silang motubo mao nga makatulo ka beses silang mag-molt sa dili pa mahimong pupa.

assignedReviews.competency_evidence: participate in a collaborative group or class task to examine and describe the topographical and geological evidence for plate boundaries occurring in the area where the Philippines is located
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about plant development and flowering. G9-E-2 involves examining topographical and geological evidence for plate boundaries in the Philippines. The card provides no support for this earth science competency.

copy.en: A mature plant has fully developed roots, stems, and leaves, and it can produce flowers that later yield fruits.
copy.tl: Ang mature plant ay may ganap nang nabuong mga ugat, tangkay, at dahon, at maaari na itong magbunga ng mga bulaklak na sa kalaunan ay magbibigay ng mga prutas.
copy.bis: Ang mature plant adunay hingpit nang naugmad nga mga gamot, punoan, ug dahon, ug makahimo na kini og mga bulak nga sa ulahi mamunga og mga prutas.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: the mole - the SI unit for amount of substance
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: determine how forces can change the shape of objects such as when they are pushed, pulled, stretched, bent, twisted, or squeezed
assignedReviews.reason: The card explains the mole as a counting unit for particles; it does not address forces changing the shape of objects.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: the mole - the SI unit for amount of substance
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: participate in guided activities to demonstrate that pushes and pulls can be used to change the speed and direction of an object including making it go faster, turn it to a different direction, slow it down, and stop it
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about counting particles with the mole, not about pushes and pulls changing speed or direction.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: the mole - the SI unit for amount of substance
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explore and demonstrate different ways to make objects move by natural causes, such as wind and water, or by people, such as pushing, pulling, rolling, and carrying
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses the mole unit, not ways to make objects move by natural causes or by people.

copy.en:
Why do chemists use a special unit just for counting tiny particles?

Atoms and molecules are far too small to count one by one, so chemists use the mole - the SI unit for amount of substance - to count huge piles of them at once.
copy.tl:
Bakit may espesyal na unit ang mga chemist para sa pagbilang ng maliliit na particle?

Napakaliit ng mga atom at molecule para bilangin isa-isa, kaya ginagamit ng mga chemist ang mole - ang SI unit para sa amount ng substance - para bilangin ang napakarami nito nang sabay-sabay.
copy.bis:
Ngano naay espesyal nga unit ang mga chemist para sa pag-ihap sa gagmay nga particle?

Gamay kaayo ang mga atom ug molecule para ihapon usa-usa, mao nga gigamit sa mga chemist ang mole - ang SI unit para sa amount sa substance - para ihap ang hilabihan ka daghan nila sa usa ka higayon.

copy.bis: Ang Pangaea usa ka supercontinent nga naglungtad mga 335 ka milyon ka tuig na ang milabay sa ulahing Paleozoic ug sayong Mesozoic era.

assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the chemical properties of materials, such as they can be burnt, react with other materials, or are degradable or biodegradable

copy.en:
Why use a special flask to make a solution?

A volumetric flask is designed to hold one exact volume, like 500 ml, so when you fill it to the line, you know the solution's volume is correct!
copy.tl:
Bakit espesyal na flask ang gamit sa paggawa ng solution?

Ang volumetric flask ay dinisenyo upang maglaman ng isang eksaktong volume, tulad ng 500 ml, kaya kapag pinuno mo ito hanggang sa linya, alam mong tama ang volume ng solution!
copy.bis:
Ngano espesyal nga flask ang gamiton sa paghimo ug solution?

Ang volumetric flask gidisenyo aron magkupot ug usa ka eksaktong volume, sama sa 500 ml, busa kon imo kining pun-on hangtod sa linya, nahibalo ka nga husto ang volume sa solution!

copy.bis: Ang thermal energy mao ang energy sa sulod sa usa ka butang tungod sa paglihok sa mga particles, ug kini mabati isip kainit.

assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explain how the subduction of an oceanic plate impacts on the plate above it
assignedReviews.reason: Card does not address subduction of oceanic plates or its impact on the overriding plate.

copy.en:
In a thermal image, what do the colors blue and red mean?

Blue and green indicate colder temperatures, while red and yellow indicate warmer temperatures, showing the body's temperature variation.
copy.tl:
Sa thermal image, ano ang ibig sabihin ng kulay asul at pula?

Ang asul at berde ay mas malamig na temperatura, habang ang pula at dilaw ay mas mainit, na nagpapakita ng pagkakaiba ng init ng katawan.
copy.bis:
Sa thermal image, unsa ang gipasabot sa kolor nga asul ug pula?

Ang asul ug berde mas bugnaw nga temperatura, samtang ang pula ug dalag mas init, nga nagpakita sa kalainan sa init sa lawas.

copy.bis: Ang butter, ice cream, ice cubes, crayons, ug kandila mahimong matunaw kon kini initon.

copy.bis: Ang mga tunok ug balhibo mao ang mga specialized structures nga makita sa uban nga terrestrial plants aron makatabang nila nga moangay sa ilang environment.

assignedReviews.reason: The card describes a parallel electrical circuit (voltage and total resistance), which is physics/electricity content. copy.en: Three 85-ohm lightbulbs connected in parallel to a 48-volt source each receive 48 volts, and the total resistance becomes about 28.57 ohms.
copy.tl: Tatlong 85-ohm na lightbulbs na nakakabit nang naka-parallel sa 48-volt na source ay bawat isa tumatanggap ng 48 volts, at ang total resistance ay nagiging mga 28.57 ohms.
copy.bis: Tulo ka 85-ohm nga lightbulbs nga konektado nga naka-parallel sa 48-volt nga source matag usa makadawat ug 48 volts, ug ang total resistance mahimong mga 28.57 ohms.

copy.bis: Ang amylase maoy moguba sa carbohydrates, ang protease maoy moguba sa mga protina, ug ang lipase maoy moguba sa mga tambok ngadto sa mas simple nga porma.

copy.tl: Ang cellular respiration ay may tatlong pangunahing yugto: glycolysis, Krebs cycle, at electron transport chain.
copy.bis: Ang cellular respiration adunay tulo ka pangunang yugto: glycolysis, Krebs cycle, ug electron transport chain.

copy.tl: Tatlong uri ng stress ang kumikilos sa mga bato: hinihila sila palayo ng tensional stress, itinutulak sila palapit ng compressional stress, at pinadudulas sila ng shear stress sa isa't isa.
copy.bis: Tulo ka klase sa stress ang molihok sa mga bato: gibira sila palayo sa tensional stress, gitulod sila paduol sa compressional stress, ug gipadahi sila sa shear stress sa usag usa.

copy.tl: Ang pharynx ay isang daanan sa likod ng lalamunan na nagsisilbing daanan para sa parehong hangin at pagkain.
copy.bis: Ang pharynx usa ka agianan sa likod sa tutunlan nga nagsilbing agianan alang sa hangin ug pagkaon.

assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe useful everyday examples of uniform and non-uniform mixtures, such as solutions and suspensions
assignedReviews.reason: The card explains why iodine is added to salt to prevent goiter (a nutrition/health topic). It does not describe uniform or non-uniform mixtures, solutions, or suspensions, nor any mixture classification. The assigned competency is unrelated to the card content.

copy.en:
Why is iodine added to Philippine salt?

The thyroid gland needs iodine to work well, so in the Philippines, salt is mixed with iodine to help prevent goiter.
copy.tl:
Bakit hinahaluan ng yodo ang asin sa Pilipinas?

Kailangan ng thyroid ng yodo para gumana nang maayos, kaya sa Pilipinas hinahaluan ng yodo ang asin para maiwasan ang goiter.
copy.bis:
Nganong gisagolan og yodo ang asin sa Pilipinas?

Nagkinahanglan ang thyroid og yodo aron molihok og maayo, mao nga sa Pilipinas gisagolan og yodo ang asin aron malikayan ang goiter.

copy.en: Decantation can be carried out by tilting the mixture after pouring out the top layer.

copy.bis: Ang decantation mahimong buhaton pinaagi sa pagkiling sa mixture human ibubo ang layer sa taas.

copy.en:
Why is a group of similar cells called a tissue?

The word tissue comes from a Latin word meaning to weave, because cells that make up tissues are sometimes woven together like threads.
copy.tl:
Bakit tinatawag na tissue ang grupo ng magkakaparehong cells?

Ang salitang tissue ay galing sa salitang Latin na ibig sabihin ay maghabi, dahil ang mga cells na bumubuo ng tissues ay minsan parang hinahabi na parang mga sinulid.
copy.bis:
Nganong gitawag ug tissue ang grupo sa parehas nga mga cells?

Ang pulong tissue naggikan sa Latin nga pulong nga nagpasabot ug paghabol, kay ang mga cells nga nagahimog tissues usahay gihabol sama sa mga hilo.

copy.en: Giving a plant too much water can harm it, causing the plant to grow poorly or even die.
copy.tl: Ang pagbibigay ng sobrang dami ng tubig sa halaman ay maaaring makasama, na nagiging sanhi ng hindi magandang paglaki o pagkamatay nito.
copy.bis: Ang paghatag ug sobra ka daghan nga tubig sa tanom makadaot, nga mahimong hinungdan sa dili maayo nga pagtubo o pagkamatay niini.

assignedReviews.reason: The card is about measuring mass with balances, which is unrelated to the competency about describing uniform and non-uniform mixtures such as solutions and suspensions. No instructional support for mixtures is provided.

copy.en: Mass is measured with a weighing scale or beam balance, and it is recorded in standard units like kilograms or grams.
copy.tl: Ang mass ay sinusukat gamit ang weighing scale o beam balance, at ito ay itinatala sa standard units tulad ng kilograms o grams.
copy.bis: Ang mass gisukod gamit ang weighing scale o beam balance, ug kini gisulat sa standard units sama sa kilograms o grams.

copy.bis: Ang toothpick kay usa ka gamay nga wedge nga modahili tali sa mga ngipon aron tangtangon ang mga pagkaon, gamit ang nipis ug talinis nga tumoy aron itulak kini pagawas.

assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe changes of state for solids, liquids, and gases as melting, evaporation, freezing, condensation using diagrams and flowcharts
assignedReviews.reason: The card teaches how to compute total microscope magnification. G6-M-1 requires describing changes of state (melting, evaporation, freezing, condensation) using diagrams/flowcharts. No overlap in content or skill.

assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe how changes in temperature cause matter to change in state, such as solid to liquid to gas
assignedReviews.reason: G5-M-6 requires describing how temperature changes cause matter to change state (solid to liquid to gas). The card is about microscope magnification, unrelated to matter states or temperature.

copy.en:
How do you find the total magnification of a microscope?

Multiply the eyepiece magnification by the objective lens magnification, so a 10x eyepiece and 50x objective give 500x.
copy.tl:
Paano makukuha ang total magnification ng microscope?

I-multiply ang magnification ng eyepiece sa magnification ng objective lens, kaya ang 10x eyepiece at 50x objective ay 500x.
copy.bis:
Unsaon pagkuha sa total magnification sa microscope?

I-multiply ang magnification sa eyepiece sa magnification sa objective lens, busa ang 10x eyepiece ug 50x objective kay 500x.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: They are gases that exist in very small amounts in the atmosphere, like carbon dioxide, ozone, argon, neon, helium, and water vapor.

What are trace gases?

They are gases that exist in very small amounts in the atmosphere, like carbon dioxide, ozone, argon, neon, helium, and water vapor.
copy.tl:
Ano ang trace gases?

Ang mga ito ay gas na umiiral sa napakaliit na dami sa atmosphere, tulad ng carbon dioxide, ozone, argon, neon, helium, at water vapor.
copy.bis:
Unsa ang trace gases?

Kini mga gas nga anaa sa hilabihan ka gamay nga gidaghanon sa atmosphere, sama sa carbon dioxide, ozone, argon, neon, helium, ug water vapor.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Transition metals have varied numbers of valence electrons

copy.en: Transition metals have varied numbers of valence electrons because their energy levels change and electrons can move between them.
copy.tl: Ang mga transition metal ay may iba't ibang bilang ng valence electrons dahil nagbabago ang kanilang mga energy level at maaaring lumipat ang mga electron sa pagitan nila.
copy.bis: Ang mga transition metal adunay lain-laing gidaghanon sa valence electrons tungod kay nag-usab ang ilang mga energy level ug ang mga electron makabalhin tali kanila.

copy.en: In transparent materials like clear glass, both transmission and refraction can happen: light passes through and may also bend.
copy.tl: Sa mga transparent na materyales tulad ng malinaw na salamin, parehong maaaring mangyari ang transmission at refraction: dumadaan ang liwanag at maaari rin itong lumiko.
copy.bis: Sa mga transparent nga materyales sama sa tin-aw nga bildo, pareho nga mahitabo ang transmission ug refraction: moagi ang kahayag ug mahimo usab kini moliko.

copy.en: Earth sends absorbed energy back upward as invisible infrared radiation, and about 90 percent of it is absorbed by greenhouse gases and redirected toward the ground.
copy.tl: Ibinabalik ng Earth ang na-absorb na enerhiya paitaas bilang invisible infrared radiation, at halos 90 porsiyento nito ay na-a-absorb ng greenhouse gases at ibinabalik pababa sa lupa.
copy.bis: Ang Yuta mobalik sa nasuhop nga enerhiya pataas isip dili makitang infrared radiation, ug mga 90 porsiyento niini masuhop sa greenhouse gases ug ibalik paubos sa yuta.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Ischemic heart disease is treated with lifestyle changes
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explain how energy from the Sun interacts with the atmosphere
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses treatment of ischemic heart disease, which is unrelated to the competency about how energy from the Sun interacts with the atmosphere. No instructional support for the Earth/space topic.

copy.en: Ischemic heart disease is treated with lifestyle changes, medicines that lower cholesterol and blood pressure, and sometimes a stent or bypass surgery to widen the narrowed arteries.
copy.tl: Ang ischemic heart disease ay ginagamot sa pamamagitan ng pagbabago ng lifestyle, mga gamot na nagpapababa ng cholesterol at presyon ng dugo, at kung minsan ay stent o bypass surgery para mapalapad ang mga kumipot na artery.
copy.bis: Ang ischemic heart disease gitambalan pinaagi sa pagbag-o sa lifestyle, mga tambal nga makapamenos sa cholesterol ug presyon sa dugo, ug usahay stent o bypass surgery aron mapalapad ang mga huot nga artery.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Cutting down trees affects the quality of the air we breathe
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the properties of pure substances as: a. having fixed chemical composition, examples of which are elements and compounds, and b. that all the atoms of an element have a unique number of protons
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses the effects of cutting down trees on air quality and temperature. It does not address pure substances, fixed chemical composition, elements, compounds, or the unique number of protons in atoms, which are the required concepts of G8-M-4.

copy.en:
What happens to the air and temperature when trees are cut down?

Cutting down trees affects the quality of the air we breathe and causes a rapid change in temperature, making it rise to uncomfortable levels.
copy.tl:
Ano ang nangyayari sa hangin at temperatura kapag pinuputol ang mga puno?

Ang pagputol ng mga puno ay nakakaapekto sa kalidad ng hanging nilalanghap natin at nagdudulot ng mabilis na pagbabago sa temperatura, na tumataas sa hindi komportableng antas.
copy.bis:
Unsa ang mahitabo sa hangin ug temperatura kung putlon ang mga kahoy?

Ang pagputol sa mga kahoy makaapekto sa kalidad sa hangin nga atong giginhawa ug magpahinabo sa paspas nga kausaban sa temperatura, nga mosaka sa dili komportable nga lebel.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Planting trees along riverbanks helps improve water quality because tree roots absorb harmful substances and hold soil in place.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify from pictures and diagrams the parts of the respiratory system as the nose, windpipe, and lungs, and describe how they work
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses tree roots improving water quality and preventing soil erosion, which is about plants and environmental science. G5-L-2 requires identifying parts of the respiratory system (nose, windpipe, lungs) and describing how they work. There is no connection to the respiratory system.

copy.en: Planting trees along riverbanks helps improve water quality because tree roots absorb harmful substances and hold soil in place.
copy.tl: Ang pagtatanim ng mga puno sa tabing-ilog ay nakakatulong sa pagpapaganda ng kalidad ng tubig dahil sinisipsip ng mga ugat ang mga mapanganib na substance at pinipigilan ang pagguho ng lupa.
copy.bis: Ang pagtanom og mga kahoy daplin sa suba makatabang sa pagpauswag sa kalidad sa tubig tungod kay ang mga gamot mosuyop sa makadaot nga mga substance ug mopugong sa paghakot sa yuta.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Volcanic eruptions cause ground vibrations called tremors, which can disturb the balance of soil on slopes and trigger volcanic landslides.

assignedReviews.reason: The card explains a volcanic hazard (tremors causing landslides). It does not address protecting or conserving the environment for living things to survive. The topic is unrelated to the competency.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Volcanic eruptions cause ground vibrations called tremors, which can disturb the balance of soil on slopes and trigger volcanic landslides.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: plan to conduct a survey to explore the possibilities for minimizing the negative impacts of human activities on an ecosystem
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes a natural volcanic process, not human activities or planning a survey to minimize negative impacts on an ecosystem. No connection to the competency's focus on human-caused ecosystem harm.

copy.en: Volcanic eruptions cause ground vibrations called tremors, which can disturb the balance of soil on slopes and trigger volcanic landslides.
copy.tl: Ang pagputok ng bulkan ay nagdudulot ng pagyanig ng lupa na tinatawag na tremors, na maaaring gumambala sa balanse ng lupa sa mga dalisdis at mag-trigger ng volcanic landslides.
copy.bis: Ang pagbuto sa bulkan makapahinabo og pag-uyog sa yuta nga gitawag og tremors, nga makasamok sa balanse sa yuta sa mga bakilid ug maka-trigger sa volcanic landslides.

assignedReviews.competency_evidence: express quantitatively the amount of solute present in a given volume of solvent
assignedReviews.reason: The card explains why scientists repeat measurements (trials) for reliability. It contains no content about solute, solvent, or expressing the amount of solute in a given volume of solvent, which is the focus of G7-M-9.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Doing trials means repeating the measurement to catch mistakes and make sure the answer is correct and reliable.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify the role of the solute and solvent in a solution
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about measurement trials and reliability, not about identifying the roles of solute and solvent in a solution. It provides no instructional support for G7-M-8.

copy.en:
Why do scientists measure something three times?

Doing trials means repeating the measurement to catch mistakes and make sure the answer is correct and reliable.
copy.tl:
Bakit tatlong beses sinusukat ng mga scientist ang isang bagay?

Ang paggawa ng trials ay inuulit ang pagsukat para mahuli ang mga pagkakamali at matiyak na tama at maaasahan ang sagot.
copy.bis:
Ngano tulo ka beses sukdon sa mga scientist ang usa ka butang?

Ang paghimo og trials nagpasabot nga gisubli ang pagsukod aron makit-an ang mga sayop ug masiguro nga husto ug kasaligan ang tubag.

assignedReviews.reason: The card is about triboelectric charging (static electricity), a physics topic. G7-L-2 requires using a microscope to observe cell parts (cell membrane, nucleus, etc.). There is no connection to cells, microscopy, or biology.

assignedReviews.competency_evidence: using information from secondary sources identify the different parts of the cell where photosynthesis and respiration occur
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes electron transfer by friction, unrelated to identifying cell parts where photosynthesis and respiration occur. This is a physics concept, not a biology competency.

copy.en: Triboelectric charging, also called charging by friction, transfers electrons between two rubbed materials.
copy.tl: Ang triboelectric charging, tinatawag ding charging by friction, ay naglilipat ng electrons sa pagitan ng dalawang materyales na kinuskos.
copy.bis: Ang triboelectric charging, gitawag usab nga charging by friction, nagbalhin sa electrons tali sa duha ka materyales nga gikuskos.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Eubacteria are true bacteria
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the general structure of the solar system, identifying the names of the major celestial objects, their main features, and general composition
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes Eubacteria, a prokaryotic single-celled organism, which is a biology topic. G5-E-11 requires describing the general structure of the solar system and major celestial objects. There is no overlap in subject matter.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Eubacteria are true bacteria
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify from pictures and diagrams the parts of the respiratory system as the nose, windpipe, and lungs, and describe how they work
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes eubacteria (true bacteria) and their peptidoglycan cell walls, which is unrelated to the respiratory system (nose, windpipe, lungs) required by G5-L-2.

copy.en: Eubacteria are true bacteria, tiny single-celled organisms whose cell walls are made of a material called peptidoglycan.
copy.tl: Ang Eubacteria ay mga tunay na bacteria, maliliit na organismong binubuo ng iisang cell na ang cell wall ay gawa sa materyal na tinatawag na peptidoglycan.
copy.bis: Ang Eubacteria mao ang tinuod nga bacteria, gagmay nga mga organismo nga usa ra ka cell nga ang cell wall gihimo sa materyal nga gitawag og peptidoglycan.

copy.en: Authorities use communication channels like sirens, loudspeakers, text messages, and social media alerts to issue tsunami warnings and guide evacuation procedures.
copy.tl: Gumagamit ang mga awtoridad ng communication channels tulad ng sirens, loudspeakers, text messages, at social media alerts para magbigay ng tsunami warnings at gabayan ang evacuation procedures.
copy.bis: Ang mga awtoridad mogamit ug communication channels sama sa sirens, loudspeakers, text messages, ug social media alerts aron maghatag ug tsunami warnings ug mogiya sa evacuation procedures.

assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify the role of the solute and solvent in a solution

assignedReviews.reason: The card contains no particle model of matter content; it is unrelated to the competency.

copy.en: If authorities instruct you, turn off gas and electricity to prevent fires and electrical accidents during a typhoon.
copy.tl: Kung inuutos ng mga awtoridad, patayin ang gas at kuryente para maiwasan ang sunog at aksidente sa kuryente tuwing may bagyo.
copy.bis: Kung gimando sa mga awtoridad, palonga ang gas ug kuryente aron malikayan ang sunog ug aksidente sa kuryente panahon sa bagyo.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Besides hearing, each ear has a part that helps you balance.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe in simple terms how the following human body systems work: muscular, skeletal, digestive, circulatory, and respiratory
assignedReviews.reason: The competency requires describing how the muscular, skeletal, digestive, circulatory, or respiratory systems work. The card discusses the ear's role in balance, which is not one of these systems and provides no instructional support for any of them.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Besides hearing, each ear has a part that helps you balance.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: observe and describe the outer body parts of animals, such as head, legs or wings, and identify their role to move and to gather food
assignedReviews.reason: The competency is about observing and describing outer body parts of animals (head, legs, wings) and their role in movement and food gathering. The card describes the inner ear's balance function, which is not an outer body part and not related to movement or food gathering.

copy.en:
Why don't you fall over?

Besides hearing, each ear has a part that helps you balance. That's why spinning fast makes you dizzy — that part briefly gets confused!
copy.tl:
Bakit hindi ka natutumba?

Bukod sa pakikinig, may parte ang bawat tainga na tumutulong sa balanse mo. Kaya kapag umiikot ka nang mabilis, nahihilo ka — pansamantalang naguguluhan ang parteng ito!
copy.bis:
Ngano nga dili ka matumba?

Gawas sa pagpaminaw, ang matag dalunggan naa'y bahin nga motabang sa imong balanse. Mao nga kung molibot ka og paspas, malipong ka — kadiyot nga nalibog ang maong bahin!

assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the indicators for a chemical reaction as color change, the formation of a precipitate, the release of gas, and or odor, or a change in temperature
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes projectile motion (horizontal constant velocity and vertical free-fall), which is a physics topic. G10-M-1 is about indicators of chemical reactions (color change, precipitate, gas, odor, temperature change). No chemical reaction content is present.

assignedReviews.reason: The card is about projectile motion, not about types of chemical reactions (combination, decomposition, single replacement, double replacement). The content is unrelated to the competency.

assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses projectile motion, not exothermic or endothermic chemical reactions. It provides no support for identifying heat changes in chemical reactions.

copy.en: Projectile motion combines two independent parts: constant-velocity horizontal motion and free-fall vertical motion, which can be analyzed separately.
copy.tl: Pinagsasama ng projectile motion ang dalawang independent na bahagi: constant-velocity horizontal motion at free-fall vertical motion, na maaaring suriin nang magkahiwalay.
copy.bis: Ang projectile motion naghiusa sa duha ka independent nga parte: constant-velocity horizontal motion ug free-fall vertical motion, nga mahimong analisahon nga gilain.

assignedReviews.reason: The card explains the two meanings of reflection (mirror image and light bouncing off a shiny surface). G7-M-9 requires expressing quantitatively the amount of solute in a given volume of solvent (concentration). The card has no connection to solutions, solutes, solvents, or quantitative concentration, so it does not support this competency.

copy.en: Reflection means two things: the image you see in a mirror, and the property of light bouncing off a shiny surface.
copy.tl: Ang reflection ay may dalawang kahulugan: ang imahe na nakikita mo sa salamin, at ang katangian ng light na tumatalbog mula sa makintab na bagay.
copy.bis: Ang reflection adunay duha ka kahulugan: ang imahe nga makita nimo sa samin, ug ang kinaiya sa light nga mopalta gikan sa sinaw nga butang.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: A projectile's motion has two parts: the horizontal component along the x-axis and the vertical component along the y-axis
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify that energy is something that can cause change including light, sound, and heat energy
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes projectile motion components, not energy as a cause of change involving light, sound, and heat. No instructional support for G4-F-9.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: A projectile's motion has two parts: the horizontal component along the x-axis and the vertical component along the y-axis
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: observe and identify sources and uses of light, sound, and heat energy at school, at home and in the local community
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about projectile motion, not sources and uses of light, sound, and heat energy. No relation to G4-F-10.

copy.en: A projectile's motion has two parts: the horizontal component along the x-axis and the vertical component along the y-axis, and they can be studied separately.
copy.tl: Ang galaw ng projectile ay may dalawang bahagi: ang horizontal component sa x-axis at ang vertical component sa y-axis, at maaari silang pag-aralan nang hiwalay.
copy.bis: Ang lihok sa projectile adunay duha ka parte: ang horizontal component sa x-axis ug ang vertical component sa y-axis, ug mahimo kini nga tun-an nga gilain.

assignedReviews.competency_evidence: recognize that scientists use models to explain phenomena that cannot be easily seen or detected
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes types of fermentation, a biological/chemical process, and provides no information about scientists using models to explain phenomena that cannot be easily seen or detected.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: The two types of fermentation are alcoholic fermentation and lactic acid fermentation.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the Particle Model of Matter as 'All matter is made up of tiny particles with each pure substance having its own kind of particles.'
assignedReviews.reason: The card does not mention the Particle Model of Matter, tiny particles, or pure substances; it is entirely about fermentation types.

copy.en: The two types of fermentation are lactic acid fermentation and alcoholic fermentation, and both use glucose as the reactant.
copy.tl: Ang dalawang uri ng fermentation ay lactic acid fermentation at alcoholic fermentation, at pareho silang gumagamit ng glucose bilang reactant.
copy.bis: Ang duha ka klase sa fermentation mao ang lactic acid fermentation ug alcoholic fermentation, ug pareho silang naggamit sa glucose isip reactant.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: A solution can form from a solid dissolving in a liquid
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the changes in the direction and length of shadows from a shadow stick and use the information to infer why the Sun changes position during a day
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes types of solutions (solid-liquid, liquid-liquid, gas-liquid), a chemistry topic. G4-E-8 is about shadow stick observations and inferring the Sun's position, which is unrelated to solutions.

copy.en: A solution can form from a solid dissolving in a liquid, a liquid mixing with another liquid, or a gas dissolving in a liquid.
copy.tl: Ang solution ay maaaring mabuo mula sa solid na natutunaw sa liquid, liquid na humahalo sa ibang liquid, o gas na natutunaw sa liquid.
copy.bis: Ang solution mahimong maporma gikan sa solid nga matunaw sa liquid, liquid nga mosagol sa laing liquid, o gas nga matunaw sa liquid.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: The rate of nuclear or radioactive decay is unchangeable
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe changes of state for solids, liquids, and gases as melting, evaporation, freezing, condensation using diagrams and flowcharts
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses nuclear/radioactive decay and PET scans, which are nuclear processes, not changes of state (melting, evaporation, freezing, condensation) of solids, liquids, and gases. No instructional support for G6-M-1.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: The rate of nuclear or radioactive decay is unchangeable
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe how changes in temperature cause matter to change in state, such as solid to liquid to gas
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about nuclear decay rate, not about how temperature changes cause matter to change state (solid to liquid to gas). No instructional support for G5-M-6.

copy.en:
Can we change the rate of every chemical reaction?

No! The rate of nuclear or radioactive decay is unchangeable, and PET scans use this steady rate to detect disease.
copy.tl:
Maaari ba nating baguhin ang rate ng bawat chemical reaction?

Hindi! Ang rate ng nuclear o radioactive decay ay hindi nababago, at ginagamit ng PET scans ang steady rate na ito para makita ang sakit.
copy.bis:
Mahimo ba natong usbon ang rate sa matag chemical reaction?

Dili! Ang rate sa nuclear o radioactive decay dili mausab, ug gigamit sa PET scans kining steady nga rate aron makita ang sakit.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Negative lifestyle weakens the immune system
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify the role of greenhouse gases in enhanced global warming and climate change

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Negative lifestyle weakens the immune system
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe air as a mixture of oxygen, carbon dioxide, nitrogen, and water vapor

copy.en:
Why do some people get sick more often than others?

Negative lifestyle weakens the immune system, the body's defense against disease, and can cause various respiratory and circulatory diseases.
copy.tl:
Bakit mas madalas magkasakit ang ibang tao kaysa sa iba?

Pinapahina ng negative lifestyle ang immune system, ang depensa ng katawan laban sa sakit, at maaaring magdulot ng iba't ibang sakit sa respiratory at circulatory systems.
copy.bis:
Ngano mas kanunay magsakit ang uban nga mga tao kaysa sa uban?

Ang negative lifestyle nagpaluya sa immune system, ang depensa sa lawas batok sa sakit, ug mahimong hinungdan sa lain-laing mga sakit sa respiratory ug circulatory systems.

assignedReviews.reason: The card describes uniform circular motion, a physics concept. G9-M-6 requires writing chemical formulas and names of ionic compounds. There is no connection to chemistry or ionic compounds.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Uniform circular motion is the movement of an object traveling at a constant speed along a circular path.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explain the formation of ions as either the loss or gain of electrons to produce ionic bonds, using examples, such as the formation of sodium chloride
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about uniform circular motion, not about ion formation or ionic bonds. G9-M-5 is a chemistry competency on electron loss/gain to form ions. The card provides no support for this competency.

copy.en: Uniform circular motion happens when an object moves in a circle at a constant speed, like a ceiling fan blade spinning steadily.
copy.tl: Ang uniform circular motion ay nangyayari kapag ang isang bagay ay gumagalaw nang paikot sa pare-parehong bilis, tulad ng blade ng electric fan na umiikot nang pantay.
copy.bis: Ang uniform circular motion mahitabo kon ang usa ka butang molihok sa lingin sa kanunay nga speed, sama sa blade sa electric fan nga nagtuyok nga makanunayon.
